event.retry: Return the original event and time; never overwrite an existing root revocation.
event.busy: Rollback source update, event and roots together; do not commit a partial cascade.

not_retroactive: Admission committed before revocation may finish.
Existing effects and execution reservations are not cancelled or released.
RETIREMENT alone does not cascade to historical roots.
MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION observes legacy inactive sources now; it is not an old signed event.
